# Bank of England RSS Taxonomy (Experiments in Agents and Data Science)

> An unofficial, agent-maintained index of everything published through the Bank of England's public RSS feeds (news, speeches, publications, statistics, PRA publications, events, explainers and Bank Insights), organised into a subject taxonomy and refreshed weekly. 403 items; last updated 2026-11-23. Not affiliated with the Bank of England; all content and links belong to the Bank.

Each entry links to the original page on bankofengland.co.uk. Themes are assigned by transparent keyword rules (see scripts/taxonomy.py). Machine-readable data: data/items.json and data/items.csv.

## Dataset

- [items.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anorthernman-developer/experiments-in-agents-and-data-science/main/data/items.json): every archived item with theme, content type, dates and link
- [items.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anorthernman-developer/experiments-in-agents-and-data-science/main/data/items.csv): the same data as CSV
- [Latest weekly digest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anorthernman-developer/experiments-in-agents-and-data-science/main/weekly/latest.md): what is new this week, grouped by theme
- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anorthernman-developer/experiments-in-agents-and-data-science/main/llms-full.txt): every item with its description in one file

## Source feeds

- [Bank Insights](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/rss/bank-insights): Short analytical pieces from Bank staff.
- [Events](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/rss/events): Conferences, workshops and Citizens' Panels hosted or attended by the Bank.
- [Explainers](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/rss/knowledgebank): Plain-English explainers on economics and the Bank.
- [News](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/rss/news): Press releases, letters, minutes and announcements.
- [Prudential regulation publications](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/rss/prudential-regulation-publications): PRA consultation papers, policy statements, discussion papers and digests.
- [Publications](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/rss/publications): Reports, papers, surveys, working papers and weekly reports.
- [Speeches](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/rss/speeches): Speeches and panels by Bank of England policymakers and staff.
- [Statistics](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/rss/statistics): Statistical releases such as Money and Credit and effective interest rates.

## Monetary Policy

Bank Rate, the MPC, inflation, the Monetary Policy Report, the Agents and the Asset Purchase Facility.

### Challenges to Monetary Policy: University of Leeds and Bank of England Workshop

- URL: https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/events/2027/february/challenges-to-monetary-policy-university-of-leeds-and-boe-workshop
- Published: 17 February 2027 00:00 (UK time)
- Content type: Events
- Feeds: events

A joint workshop bringing together academics and policymakers to discuss contemporary and future challenges in monetary policy and central banking. The event will showcase cutting-edge theoretical and empirical research and provide an opportunity for engagement between researchers and practitioners.

### Inflation in central sectors with rigid prices: a granular measure of underlying inflationary pressures

- URL: https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/bank-insights/2026/inflation-in-central-sectors-with-rigid-prices
- Published: 19 October 2026 12:00 (UK time)
- Content type: Bank Insights
- Feeds: bank-insights

Not all inflation is created equal. By placing greater weight on inflation in sectors with rigid prices and in central positions in the economy, this novel measure aims to better capture the broad-based inflationary pressures monetary policy can and should address, in pursuit of the existing remit.

### Asset Purchase Facility: Gilt Sales – Market Notice 17 September 2026

- URL: https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/markets/market-notices/2026/asset-purchase-facility-gilt-sales-market-notice-17-september-2026
- Published: 17 September 2026 12:00 (UK time)
- Content type: News
- Feeds: news

This Market Notice outlines the Bank Executive’s approach to implementing the Monetary Policy Committee’s (MPC) decision to unwind the gilts held for monetary policy purposes in the Asset Purchase Facility (APF). As part of this, Bank APF auctions will be paused while the Bank reviews a model of selling gilts to the Government.

### Project Meridian FX APAC: Technical Report

- URL: https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/payments/payments-innovation/wholesale-experiments-programme/project-meridian-fx-apac-technical-report
- Published: 13 November 2026 09:00 (UK time)
- Content type: Publications
- Feeds: publications

This page summarises the technical findings of Project Meridian FX APAC, a joint experiment which explored how synchronisation can support PvP FX transactions between the Bank of England, Monetary Authority of Singapore and Bank of Thailand. It sets out the experiment’s objectives, design and findings.

### Project Meridian FX APAC: Policy Report

- URL: https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/payments/payments-innovation/wholesale-experiments-programme/project-meridian-fx-apac-policy-report
- Published: 13 November 2026 09:00 (UK time)
- Content type: Publications
- Feeds: publications

This page summarises the policy findings of Project Meridian FX APAC, a joint experiment on synchronisation in FX between the Bank of England, Monetary Authority of Singapore and Bank of Thailand, with the Reserve Bank of Australia and Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas as observers. It sets out the key policy conclusions from the experiment and considerations for a live service.

### Project Meridian FX APAC: Executive summary and introduction

- URL: https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/payments/payments-innovation/wholesale-experiments-programme/project-meridian-fx-apac-executive-summary-and-introduction
- Published: 13 November 2026 09:00 (UK time)
- Content type: Publications
- Feeds: publications

This page explains why the project matters, what was tested, the main insights, and how the technical and policy reports should be read together.
